emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: Addresses to verify. Paste one per line.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Verify the output of a lead scraper directly. Paste the dataset ID of a finished run (Google Maps Email Extractor, Leads Finder, Contact Details Scraper, ...).

emailField.title: Field that holds the email
emailField.description: Field name in the dataset items. Nested fields use dots (contact.email). Arrays of emails are supported (emails).

maxEmails.title: Maximum addresses
maxEmails.description: Stop reading input after this many addresses.

dnsOnly.title: Skip mailbox (SMTP) check
dnsOnly.description: Only check syntax and whether the domain can receive mail. Fast. Charges only for domains proven unable to receive mail.

concurrency.title: Domains checked in parallel
concurrency.description: Each domain is contacted by one connection at a time regardless of this value.

heloName.title: HELO name (advanced)
heloName.description: Hostname to announce to mail servers. Leave empty to announce this run's own IP address.
heloName.sectionDescription: Leave these empty unless you know you need them.

mailFrom.title: Envelope sender (advanced)
mailFrom.description: Leave empty to use the null sender, as mail servers do when they verify each other. No message is ever sent.
